source_title: AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Notification Out: 254 PGT, TGT, PRT & Other Vacancies - FreeJobAlert.Com
source_excerpt:
AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026: The Atomic Energy Education Society (AEES), an autonomous body under the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India, has issued Recruitment Notification 01/2026 for 254 teaching and related vacancies , including Principal, Vice-Principal, PGT, TGT, Librarian, Primary Teacher (PRT), PRT Music and Balvatika Teacher. Candidates with the prescribed 12th Pass, Graduation, Postgraduation, teaching qualifications, CTET or relevant experience can apply according to the post requirements. The pay scales range from Rs. 35,400 to Rs. 2,09,200 across Pay Levels 6 to 12. Eligible candidates can apply online from 2 November 2026 to 22 November 2026 through aees.onlineregistrationforms.com .
AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 - Overview
Important: Educational qualifications, CTET requirements, experience and maximum age vary by post. Candidates selected for AEES institutions may be posted anywhere in India, and requests for a change of initial posting location will not be entertained.
AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
Candidates must complete online registration, application submission and fee payment before the prescribed deadline. The admit card and examination dates will be announced through the AEES application portal.
AEES has announced 254 tentative vacancies across teaching, school leadership and library positions. The largest number of vacancies is for Primary Teacher, with 89 posts.
PwBD Reservation: Twelve vacancies are identified for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities under horizontal reservation. These vacancies are included within the total of 254 and must not be added separately.
All vacancy figures are tentative and may increase or decrease according to AEES requirements.
AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
The Atomic Energy Education Society has issued Recruitment Notification 01/2026 for 254 posts across its schools in India. The detailed notification includes category-wise and subject-wise vacancies, academic qualifications, age relaxation, selection rules, application fees, examination patterns and document requirements.
Official Recruitment Notices: AEES Recruitment Notice PDF
AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
Applicants must satisfy the prescribed educational qualification, teacher-training requirements, CTET conditions and experience rules for their selected post. The notification provides different eligibility routes for school leadership, postgraduate teaching and primary-level teaching positions.
Important: The table summarizes the principal qualification routes. Candidates must verify the exact subject combinations, minimum marks, alternative qualifications and experience requirements in Recruitment Notification 01/2026 before applying.
Principal candidates must have a Master's Degree with at least 50% marks, a qualifying B.Ed. or integrated teacher-education qualification with at least 50% marks, and computer knowledge.
They must also satisfy one of the prescribed experience routes:
Working as Principal in Pay Level 12 in an eligible Government or autonomous organization.
Three years as Vice-Principal in Pay Level 10.
Twelve years of regular service as PGT/Lecturer in Pay Level 8.
Twelve years of combined qualifying service as PGT and Vice-Principal under the notified conditions.
Vice-Principal applicants must have a Master's Degree with at least 50% marks, the prescribed teacher-education qualification, and computer knowledge.
Eligible experience routes include working as Vice-Principal in Pay Level 10 or at least six years as PGT/Lecturer in Pay Level 8 in the specified Government or autonomous organizations.
AEES TGT Subject Combination Requirements
The notification specifies subject combinations for certain TGT positions that must be satisfied at Graduation level.
Important: The notification specifically states that candidates with B.Sc. (Hons.) in Physics or Chemistry are not eligible for TGT Mathematics-Physics. Applicants must satisfy the relevant subject combination rather than relying only on their degree title.
CTET is mandatory for the applicable TGT and PRT posts.
The CTET certificate must be valid and issued on or before the application closing date wherever CTET is compulsory. Candidates should refer to the post-specific eligibility provisions for the exact requirement.
The maximum age varies from 30 to 50 years depending on the post. Principal and Vice-Principal positions also have a minimum age requirement of 35 years.
All candidates must be at least 18 years old. Age and eligibility will be calculated with reference to the original online application closing date, even if that date is subsequently extended.
Important: Age concessions are concurrent, not cumulative. Candidates eligible for multiple concessions will receive only the highest permissible relaxation. The separate women-candidate relaxation does not apply to Principal or Vice-Principal posts.
AEES posts carry pay scales under the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, ranging from Level 6 to Level 12 .
The listed amounts are pay scales, not fixed in-hand salaries. Actual monthly earnings will depend on the applicable pay level, allowances and deductions.
AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
The application fee is Rs. 750 plus Rs. 250 processing fee for non-exempt candidates. Women, SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen applicants are exempted from the application fee but must pay the processing fee.
Note: Applicable GST charged by the bank is additional. Payment can be made online using Debit Card, Credit Card or Net Banking. Fees paid through other modes are not accepted, and application fees once remitted are non-refundable.
Candidates applying for multiple permitted posts must pay the requisite fee separately for each post.
AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
Selection includes a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by an Interview for Principal and Vice-Principal or a qualifying Skill Test for other posts. Medical fitness is also required before appointment.
Interview for Principal and Vice-Principal, or Skill Test for teaching and Librarian posts.
Verification of educational qualifications, experience and applicable certificates.
Medical fitness examination before appointment.
Selection for Principal and Vice-Principal
Final selection for Principal and Vice-Principal is based on 50% CBT marks and 50% Interview marks , subject to meeting the prescribed qualifying standards separately in both stages.
Selection for PGT, TGT, Librarian, PRT and Balvatika Teacher
These candidates must qualify in the CBT and then undergo a teaching skill test conducted on a Go / No Go basis . The skill test is qualifying only, and final merit is based on CBT marks among candidates awarded Go.
The skill test assesses teaching ability through a chalk-and-board demonstration on a subject-oriented topic. Candidates receiving No Go will not be empanelled regardless of CBT marks.
AEES Teacher Syllabus & Exam Pattern 2026
The CBT pattern differs for school leadership and other posts. The notification specifies no negative marking .
PGT, TGT, Librarian, PRT and Balvatika Teacher CBT Pattern
Exam Duration: 2 Hours. Negative Marking: No.
AEES may lower the qualifying threshold within the notified limits if an insufficient number of candidates qualify for a particular post or category. Meeting the minimum standard does not automatically guarantee shortlisting for Skill Test or Interview.
AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Exam Centres
The Computer Based Test is tentatively planned across multiple cities in India, including Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Patna, Lucknow, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Bhubaneswar, Pune and other listed centres.
AEES may change, cancel or reallocate examination centres according to administrative requirements. The Skill Test and Interview will be conducted at AEES, Anushaktinagar, Mumbai .
AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
Eligible candidates can apply online through the dedicated AEES Recruitment Notification 01/2026 application portal from 2 November 2026 at 10:00 AM .
Apply Online: AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Application Portal
Applicants must select the correct post and subject. Within PGT posts, candidates can apply for only one PGT subject; similarly, candidates can apply for only one TGT subject, even when qualified for multiple subjects.
How to Apply Online for AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026?
Visit the official AEES recruitment portal at aees.onlineregistrationforms.com .
Read Recruitment Notification 01/2026 and the applicable post-specific eligibility conditions.
Register using a valid personal email ID and mobile number.
Select the relevant post and permitted subject.
Enter personal, educational qualification, experience and category details.
Upload the photograph and required documents according to the portal instructions.
Review the application and supporting information carefully.
Pay the applicable application and processing fees online.
Complete final submission and generate the Confirmation Page.
Download and print the Confirmation Page for future reference.
Important: Applications without a generated Confirmation Page will be treated as incomplete. Candidates should not send application printouts to the AEES office by post.
Documents Required for AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026
Candidates must upload scanned documents relevant to their selected post and produce the required originals and self-attested copies during verification.
Recent colour photograph in the prescribed format.
Class 10 certificate or marksheet for date-of-birth proof.
Class 12 certificate and marksheet, where applicable.
Graduation degree and semester/year-wise marksheets.
Postgraduate degree and marksheets, where applicable.
B.Ed., D.El.Ed., B.El.Ed., Nursery Education or other prescribed teacher-training certificates.
CTET Paper-I or Paper-II certificate, where required.
Experience and service certificates for Principal, Vice-Principal or other applicable posts.
SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificate, if applicable.
PwBD certificate and relevant supporting documents, where applicable.
No Objection Certificate for serving employees, where required.
Other documents prescribed by the online portal for the selected post.
Document Scanning Requirement: The notification instructs candidates to use a proper scanner rather than a mobile phone camera or scanning application. File-size and format specifications must be followed as displayed on the recruitment portal.
Candidates reaching the Skill Test or Interview stage must satisfy the notified Police Verification Certificate requirements. Serving employees of the specified Government, PSU and autonomous organizations must produce the applicable original NOC and vigilance clearance.
AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
The recruitment is for 254 tentative vacancies under Notification 01/2026.
Applications are accepted online through the dedicated AEES portal only.
The online application window is 2 November to 22 November 2026.
Post-specific qualifications and CTET requirements must be satisfied by the prescribed eligibility cut-off.
Applicants can select only one subject within the PGT category and only one subject within the TGT category.
Separate fees apply when applying for different permitted posts.
Principal and Vice-Principal selection uses CBT and Interview marks with 50:50 weightage.
Other notified posts require a qualifying Go / No Go Skill Test after CBT.
Admit cards and call letters must be downloaded from the candidate login.
Applicants may be posted anywhere in India.
All appointment offers are subject to document verification and medical fitness.
AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Important Links
Have questions about eligibility , dates , or vacancies ? Found incorrect information ? The FreeJobAlert team is here to help.
Q1. How many vacancies are available in AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026?
AEES Recruitment Notification 01/2026 announces 254 vacancies, including Principal, Vice-Principal, PGT, TGT, Librarian, Primary Teacher, PRT Music and Balvatika Teacher posts.
Q2. What is the last date to apply for AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026?
The last date to submit the online application and complete fee payment is 22 November 2026 at 11:50 PM.
Q3. What is the qualification for AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026?
Qualifications vary by post and include 12th Pass with prescribed teacher-training credentials, Graduation, Postgraduation, B.Ed., CTET and relevant experience for applicable positions.
Q4. What is the age limit for AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026?
The maximum age is 30 years for PRT and Balvatika, 35 years for TGT and Librarian, 40 years for PGT, 45 years for Vice-Principal and 50 years for Principal, subject to applicable relaxation.
Q5. What is the AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 application fee?
Non-exempt candidates must pay Rs. 750 application fee plus Rs. 250 processing fee. Women, SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates pay only the Rs. 250 processing fee. Applicable GST is additional.
Q6. Is CTET mandatory for AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026?
CTET Paper-I is required for Primary Teacher and CTET Paper-II for applicable TGT posts. The notification provides exemptions for certain specialist teaching positions.
Q7. What is the AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 selection process?
Selection includes CBT followed by an Interview for Principal and Vice-Principal or a qualifying Skill Test for other posts. Medical fitness and document verification are also required.
Q8. Is there negative marking in the AEES CBT?
No. The notification specifically states that there is no negative marking in the Computer Based Test.
Q9. What is the salary for AEES teaching posts?
The posts fall under Pay Levels 6 to 12, with pay scales ranging from Rs. 35,400-1,12,400 for Level 6 positions to Rs. 78,800-2,09,200 for Principal.
Q10. Can candidates apply for more than one AEES teaching post?
Candidates may apply for different permitted posts with separate fees. However, only one subject can be selected within PGT and only one subject within TGT.

## AEES शिक्षण भर्ती 2026 अवलोकन
परमाणु ऊर्जा शिक्षा सोसायटी (AEES) ने वर्ष 2026 के लिए भर्ती अधिसूचना 01/2026 जारी कर दी है। इसके तहत कुल 254 शिक्षण और संबंधित पदों पर नियुक्तियां की जाएंगी। इनमें प्रिंसिपल, वाइस-प्रिंसिपल, पीजीटी (PGT), टीजीटी (TGT), लाइब्रेरियन, प्राइमरी टीचर (PRT), पीआरटी म्यूजिक और बालवाटिका टीचर के पद शामिल हैं। 

## महत्वपूर्ण तिथियां
* ऑनलाइन आवेदन शुरू होने की तिथि: 2 नवंबर 2026
* ऑनलाइन आवेदन की अंतिम तिथि: 22 नवंबर 2026

## रिक्तियों का विवरण
विभिन्न पदों को मिलाकर कुल 254 संभावित रिक्तियां घोषित की गई हैं। इसमें प्राथमिक शिक्षक (PRT) के सबसे अधिक 89 पद शामिल हैं। दिव्यांग उम्मीदवारों (PwBD) के लिए क्षैतिज आरक्षण के तहत 12 पद आरक्षित हैं, जो कुल 254 पदों में ही शामिल हैं।

## पात्रता मानदंड और आयु सीमा
विभिन्न पदों के लिए शैक्षणिक योग्यताएं, जैसे 12वीं पास, स्नातक, परास्नातक, बीएड (B.Ed) और सीटीईटी (CTET) की अनिवार्यता पद के अनुसार अलग-अलग निर्धारित की गई है।
* **आयु सीमा:** विभिन्न पदों के अनुसार अधिकतम आयु सीमा 30 वर्ष से 50 वर्ष तक है। प्रिंसिपल और वाइस-प्रिंसिपल के पदों के लिए न्यूनतम आयु 35 वर्ष तय की गई है।
* आरक्षित श्रेणियों के नियमों के अनुसार आयु में छूट दी जाएगी।

## आवेदन शुल्क
* सामान्य और अन्य गैर-छूट प्राप्त उम्मीदवारों के लिए: 750 रुपये आवेदन शुल्क + 250 रुपये प्रोसेसिंग शुल्क।
* महिला, एससी, एसटी, पीडब्ल्यूडी और एक्स-सर्विसमैन उम्मीदवारों के लिए: केवल 250 रुपये प्रोसेसिंग शुल्क (आवेदन शुल्क माफ)।
* भुगतान ऑनलाइन माध्यम से डेबिट कार्ड, क्रेडिट कार्ड या नेट बैंकिंग के जरिए किया जा सकेगा।

## चयन प्रक्रिया
चयन प्रक्रिया में कंप्यूटर आधारित परीक्षा (CBT) शामिल है। 
* प्रिंसिपल और वाइस-प्रिंसिपल के लिए CBT के बाद साक्षात्कार (Interview) होगा।
* अन्य शिक्षण और लाइब्रेरियन पदों के लिए CBT के बाद 'गो / नो गो' (Go/No Go) आधार पर स्किल टेस्ट लिया जाएगा।
* इसके बाद दस्तावेजों का सत्यापन और मेडिकल फिटनेस परीक्षण होगा।

## आवेदन कैसे करें
1. आधिकारिक वेबसाइट aees.onlineregistrationforms.com पर जाएं।
2. भर्ती अधिसूचना 01/2026 को ध्यान से पढ़ें।
3. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर के साथ पंजीकरण करें।
4. अपने पद का चयन करें और सभी आवश्यक विवरण भरें।
5. निर्धारित प्रारूप में दस्तावेज अपलोड करें और शुल्क का भुगतान करें।
6. अंतिम रूप से सबमिट करने के बाद कन्फर्मेशन पेज डाउनलोड कर सुरक्षित रख लें।
